title: Expose how school systems collect, use, and abuse student data

defaults.5_deliverable: Standalone exposé site + evidence pipeline + portfolio project page
defaults.7_audience: Primary: students/parents; secondary: hiring managers + policymakers
defaults.9_complete_means: Working product with real evidence for one school, then reusable framework

rule: No forward movement past a major gate without a recorded decision interview
